Private Function Groups(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim g As Object, s As String
    For Each g In ws.Cells.SparklineGroups
        s = s & "|" & g.Type & ":" & g.Location.Address(False, False) & ":" & g.SourceData
    Next
    Groups = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:D4").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array(1, 3, -2, 4), Array(-1, 2, -3, 4), Array(5, 4, 3, 2), Array(2, 2, 2, 2))))
    On Error GoTo Failed
    ws.Range("E1:E2").SparklineGroups.Add xlSparkLine, "A1:D2"
    ws.Range("E3").SparklineGroups.Add xlSparkColumn, "A3:D3"
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Tried = Groups(ws)
    Case 1
        ws.Range("E2").SparklineGroups.ClearGroups
        Tried = Groups(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\cleargroups.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        ws.Range("E1:E3").SparklineGroups.Group ws.Range("E3")
        Tried = Groups(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\grouped.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        ws.Range("E1:E3").SparklineGroups.Group ws.Range("E1")
        Tried = Groups(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\grouped1.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        ws.Range("E2").SparklineGroups.Ungroup
        Tried = Groups(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ungrouped.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        ws.Range("E1:E2").SparklineGroups.Ungroup
        Tried = Groups(ws)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\ungrouped2.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 6
        ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Group ws.Range("E3")
        Tried = Groups(ws)
    Case 7
        ws.Range("E3").SparklineGroups.Group ws.Range("E1")
        Tried = Groups(ws)
    Case 8
        ws.Range("E1:E3").SparklineGroups.Group ws.Range("H9")
        Tried = Groups(ws)
    Case 9
        ws.Range("E1:E3").SparklineGroups.ClearGroups
        Tried = Groups(ws)
    Case 10
        ws.Range("G1").SparklineGroups.ClearGroups
        Tried = Groups(ws)
    Case 11
        ws.Range("G1").SparklineGroups.Ungroup
        Tried = Groups(ws)
    Case 12
        ws.Range("E1:E3").SparklineGroups(1).Points.Markers.Visible = True
        ws.Range("E1:E3").SparklineGroups.Group ws.Range("E3")
        Tried = Groups(ws) & " " & ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups(1).Points.Markers.Visible
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\kept.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 12
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
